description: Look up one ZPL command in the maintained catalog: name, syntax, parameters (types, ranges, defaults) and whether the preview engine actually renders it — printer-side commands are honestly marked as not rendered.

command.description: Command code with or without prefix, e.g. ^PO, BC, ~DG

locale.description: Language for the name and descriptions (default English). Command codes, syntax strings, examples and parameter names are protocol and never change.

name: zpl_command_help
